meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 它接手 v1 到 v2 迁移的收尾:读取迁移进度,先确保新机器人能正常收发消息,再把你设为所有者、设定谁能访问、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置,处理你改过的代码,最后验证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”等关键词时接管;它会先检查迁移脚本是否已运行,没跑会先要求你运行。

say.text: 继续完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: 它会读取迁移进度并开始收尾。

say.text: 把我设为所有者并设置谁能访问机器人
say.note: 它会确认你的身份并调整访问策略。

say.text: 迁移 v1 的旧记忆和定制代码
say.note: 它会运行记忆迁移并跟你确认定制代码的处理方式。

howto.what_en: Finishes a v1→v2 migration: reads the handoff, fixes message-routing blockers, grants owner role, lets you choose access policy, migrates legacy memory, checks container configs, handles forked code, then verifies and restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'migrate from v1' or 'finish migration'. It first checks if the migration script has run; if not, tells you to run it.

say_en.text: Continue finishing the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: It reads the handoff and starts the final steps.

say_en.text: Make me the owner and set who can message the bot.
say_en.note: It confirms your identity and sets the access policy.

say_en.text: Migrate the old memory and custom v1 code.
say_en.note: Runs memory migration and asks how to handle forks.
